contracts.name: investigate_feature
contracts.title: Investigate a feature
contracts.description: Trace a feature through relevant artifact, symbol, and function evidence while distinguishing observations, inferences, and residual unknowns.
contracts.objective: Explain how the requested feature is represented and connected without claiming recovery of original source or behavior not supported by complete evidence.

feature.description: Feature, behavior, string, or symbol to investigate

target_path.description: Absolute target path; omit when the intended target is already open

procedure.description: Known procedure name or address to prioritize

provider_id.description: Configured provider identity to prefer when its capability is available

steps.instruction: For a JavaScript/Electron application directory, call analyze_javascript_application with input_path=target_path directly; no open_binary call is needed. For a file or macOS app bundle, open target_path only when the required target is not active.
Analysis stays bound to the active target's provider document. Use open_binary to switch targets; document names never select another artifact.
Search relevant strings or procedures and analyze the matching procedures; pass names or addresses directly when already known.

When inspect_binary_layout or analyze_javascript_application Evidence is already retained, call inspect_analysis_view with that evidence_id for a summary, one section/symbol/module, or a stable page. Do not re-run the producer. Use trace_application_feature once a route, API, channel, module, string, or native export seed is known.
Build function dossiers and corroborate references and call relationships. Keep indirect or truncated paths unknown.
Use Evidence returned inline. Record a residual unknown when an unanswered material question needs to be tracked.

contracts.name: compare_application_versions
contracts.title: Compare application versions
contracts.description: Compare two shipped application artifacts through complete inventory and optional static or runtime evidence without equating missing data with unchanged behavior.
contracts.objective: Identify evidence-backed artifact, function, and observed runtime differences between two versions and preserve every unresolved comparison frontier.

left_target_path.description: Absolute path to the earlier or baseline target

right_target_path.description: Absolute path to the later or candidate target

left_manifest_id.description: Retained baseline artifact graph manifest to reuse or validate

right_manifest_id.description: Retained candidate artifact graph manifest to reuse or validate

focus_occurrence_id.description: Retained artifact occurrence to prioritize without authorizing extraction

steps.instruction: For each supplied target path, open that target before inspection because inspect_artifact uses the active target and accepts no path. Retain the returned graph, substep Evidence, integrity findings, and next probes for each manifest.

For JavaScript/Electron versions, reconstruct each artifact and compare the resulting graphs; reconcile passive runtime Evidence when it helps answer the question. Keep ambiguous and incomplete matches unknown.
Compare the inventory Evidence returned by each inspection.
When code-level localization is needed, analyze corresponding functions on both targets and compare their Evidence.
Use controlled runtime comparisons when runtime behavior is relevant, and keep those observations distinct from static candidates.
Preserve unmatched paths, incomplete pages, provider differences, and causal uncertainty; record material residual unknowns when useful.

contracts.name: verify_reconstruction
contracts.title: Verify a reconstruction
contracts.description: Evaluate a finite reconstruction specification against retained Evidence comparisons without broadening pass results into global equivalence claims.
contracts.objective: Produce per-claim pass, fail, or unknown results backed by compatible comparison Evidence and exact authority requirements.

reconstruction_goal.description: Finite behavior or structure the reconstruction is expected to satisfy

comparison_evidence_id.description: Retained comparison Evidence to use in a declared claim

provider_id.description: Provider identity whose Evidence is relevant to the reconstruction

steps.instruction: Produce missing comparison Evidence when needed; incomplete comparison dimensions remain unknown.
Construct a finite typed specification using the comparison Evidence already returned in this session. Interpret pass only for the declared claim and dimension.
Report verification unknowns and the authority needed to resolve them. Record new unknowns when they need to be tracked.

contracts.name: trace_crash
contracts.title: Trace a crash
contracts.description: Correlate a crash symptom with static call and reference evidence plus optional process capture observations.
contracts.objective: Localize plausible crash paths while separating observed runtime failure, static reachability, inferred causality, and unobserved paths.

crash_signal.description: Crash message, exception, signal, address, or reproducible symptom

target_path.description: Absolute target path; omit when the intended target is already open

procedure.description: Known crash-adjacent procedure name or address

capture_evidence_id.description: Retained process capture Evidence for the crash

steps.instruction: Confirm the target only when needed; open or analyze it if it is not already active and the request requires it.
Resolve crash text or addresses to function dossiers; do not infer a source location from symbol similarity alone.
Trace corroborated references and caller paths; unresolved indirect calls remain unknown.

Reuse a supplied capture when relevant; otherwise capture a bounded runtime reproduction when it can distinguish competing explanations. Correlate through explicit hypotheses rather than timing or name coincidence.
Separate the observed crash from inferred cause and record missing reproduction or authority as residual unknowns.

contracts.name: audit_residual_unknowns
contracts.title: Audit residual unknowns
contracts.description: Review current residual-unknown heads against retained evidence, revision integrity, and declared authority without silently closing unanswered questions.
contracts.objective: Determine which unknowns remain open, contradicted, blocked, or truthfully resolved and identify evidence-producing next probes.

audit_scope.description: Decision, risk, or investigation scope the unknown audit must support

unknown_id.description: Active residual unknown to audit; omit to review every active head

evidence_id.description: Retained Evidence record relevant to the audit

steps.instruction: List current heads and select the unknowns relevant to the audit. Preserve their exact revisions and requirements.
Validate any resolved head against its cited Evidence and authority requirements.
Update an unknown when evidence supports it, using its current expected_revision to guard against concurrent changes.
Record a distinct unanswered question when it should be tracked.

contracts.name: prepare_bounded_process_capture
contracts.title: Prepare a bounded process capture
contracts.description: Choose a command, inputs, observations, and stopping conditions for a process capture that answers the behavioral question.
contracts.objective: Run a caller-selected process experiment that can answer the stated behavioral question.

behavior_question.description: Behavioral question the capture must answer and stopping condition

executable.description: Command name or executable path requested for the scenario

working_directory.description: Working directory requested for the scenario

prior_capture_evidence_id.description: Retained process capture Evidence to compare or refine

steps.instruction: Run the caller-provided scenario. Explain command lookup, effective working directory, inherited environment, optional filesystem observations, and that the target runs with the current user's permissions.
When a prior compatible capture exists, compare complete process capture observations under recorded normalization and freshness requirements.
Treat sampling gaps, genuinely truncated output, external behavior, and cleanup uncertainty as residual unknowns; cite relevant Evidence and suggest focused probes.
